title: Central Excises and Salt Amendment Ordinance 1979

sections.shortTitle: Central Excises and Salt Amendment Ordinance 1979
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1979
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1979
CENTRAL EXCISES AND SALT
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to
amend the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March 1979]
No. F. 17 (1)/79‑Pub.‑The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Central Excises and Salt (Amendment)
Ordinance,, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to
amend the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March 1979]
No. F. 17 (1)/79‑Pub.‑The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of First
Schedule, Act 1 of 1944.‑‑In
the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 (I of 1944), in the First Schedule, in
Part I, for item No. 6 in column (1) and the entries relating thereto in
columns (2) and (3) the following shall be substituted, namely:-
6. Beverages‑
(1) Aerated waters, allsorts‑
(a) filled in containers containing less than 260
millilitres.
25 paisa per bottle or can.
(b) filled in containers containing 260 millilitres
or more.
One rupee per litre or fraction thereof.
(2) Syrups, squashes aniruit juices, all sorts
(a) if retail price is legibly, prominently and
indelibly printed on each bottle or on the crown cork or on the label;
17
percent. of the retail price.
(b) if not covered by c muse (a)
200 per cent. ad valo. Rem."
